decisions.reason: The multi-model formwork profile line has its own page and sits at the core of the integrated formwork offer, so after four years of investment and public presentation the firm will keep it, even though it was not observed on the website in 2020 and 2021.
The shuttering magnet block line is a cheap, established part of the magnetic formwork range that customers buy repeatedly, and keeping it costs little.
The magnetic formwork strips are a multi-model line with a dedicated page that fits the firm's core automation and formwork direction, which makes dropping them hard to justify.
This component has its own web presence and complements the integrated system, and any weak demand during 2020 and 2021 can be put down to temporary pandemic and construction-cycle effects.
This component has the lowest visible commitment and overlaps with other magnetic parts, but it still rounds out the system offering at minimal cost, so the firm will persist with it.
